```js
        reset() {
            this.state = STATES.IDLE;
            this.currentFloor = 0;
            this.carY = 0;
            this.direction = 0;
            this.targetFloor = null;
            this.upCalls = new Set();
            this.downCalls = new Set();
            this.destinations = new Set();
            this.passengers = new Set();
            this.pendingBoarders = new Map();
            this.pendingDisembark = new Set();
            this.spotOccupancy = [null, null, null, null];
            this.doorOpenness = 0;
            this.doorTimer = 0;
            this.lastServedFloor = null;
        }

        callUp(floor) { if (floor >= 0 && floor < this.floorCount) this.upCalls.add(floor); }
        callDown(floor) { if (floor >= 0 && floor < this.floorCount) this.downCalls.add(floor); }
        pressDestination(floor) { if (floor >= 0 && floor < this.floorCount) this.destinations.add(floor); }

        isAcceptingAt(floor, direction) {
            if (this.state !== STATES.DOOR_OPEN || this.currentFloor !== floor) return false;
            if (this.direction === 0 || this.direction === direction) return true;
            return !this._hasStopInDirection(this.direction);
        }

        currentCapacityFree() {
            return this.maxCapacity - (this.passengers.size + this.pendingBoarders.size);
        }

        reserveBoardingSpot(person) {
            if (this.currentCapacityFree() <= 0) return null;
            if (this.pendingBoarders.has(person)) {
                const existing = this.pendingBoarders.get(person);
                return { index: existing.index, x: existing.x, y: 0, z: existing.z };
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < this.spotOccupancy.length; i++) {
                if (this.spotOccupancy[i] === null) {
                    this.spotOccupancy[i] = person;
                    const spot = { index: i, x: INTERIOR_SPOTS[i].x, y: 0, z: INTERIOR_SPOTS[i].z };
                    this.pendingBoarders.set(person, spot);
                    return { index: spot.index, x: spot.x, y: 0, z: spot.z };
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        completeBoard(person) {
            if (!this.pendingBoarders.has(person)) return;
            this.pendingBoarders.delete(person);
            this.passengers.add(person);
        }

        registerDisembark(person) { this.pendingDisembark.add(person); }

        completeDisembark(person) {
            this.pendingDisembark.delete(person);
            this.passengers.delete(person);
            for (let i = 0; i < this.spotOccupancy.length; i++) {
                if (this.spotOccupancy[i] === person) { this.spotOccupancy[i] = null; break; }
            }
        }

        _hasStopInDirection(dir) {
            if (dir === 0) return false;
            for (let f = 0; f < this.floorCount; f++) {
                if (f === this.currentFloor) continue;
                if (dir > 0 ? f < this.currentFloor : f > this.currentFloor) continue;
                if (this.destinations.has(f)) return true;
                if (dir > 0 && this.upCalls.has(f)) return true;
                if (dir < 0 && this.downCalls.has(f)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        _nearestStopInDirection(dir) {
            let best = null;
            for (let f = 0; f < this.floorCount; f++) {
                if (f === this.currentFloor) continue;
                if (dir > 0 ? f <= this.currentFloor : f >= this.currentFloor) continue;
                const isStop = this.destinations.has(f) || (dir > 0 ? this.upCalls.has(f) : this.downCalls.has(f));
                if (!isStop) continue;
                if (best === null || Math.abs(f - this.currentFloor) < Math.abs(best - this.currentFloor)) best = f;
            }
            return best;
        }
        
        tick(dt) {
            switch (this.state) {
                case STATES.IDLE: this._tickIdle(); break;
                case STATES.MOVING: this._tickMoving(dt); break;
                case STATES.DOOR_OPENING: ...
                ...
            }
        }
        ...
    }
```

Render loop uses clock via performance.now: realDt = min(0.05, (now - lastT)/1000). Simpler: keep lastTime manually. Spec says `clock.getDelta()` — I'll implement Clock.getDelta using performance.now.

```
const Clock = {
    simMinute: 7 * 60 + 30,
    timeScale: 120,
    _lastMs: null,
    getDelta() {
        const now = performance.now();
        if (this._lastMs === null) { this._lastMs = now; return 0; }
        const dt = (now - this._lastMs) / 1000;
        this._lastMs = now;
        return dt;
    },
    tick(realDt) {
        this.simMinute += realDt * this.timeScale / 60;
        if (this.simMinute >= 24 * 60) { this.simMinute -= 24 * 60; resetDay(); }
    },
    format() {
        let h = Math.floor(this.simMinute / 60) % 24;
        const m = Math.floor(this.simMinute % 60);
        const ap = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
        let hh = h % 12; if (hh === 0) hh = 12;
        return " " + hh + ":" + (m < 10 ? "0" + m : m) + " " + ap;
    }
};
```

updateAction(agent, a, dt) returns true if done:

WALK_TO_WP:
```
const speed = 1.3;
if (a.idx >= a.path.length) return true;
const target = a.path[a.idx];
const pos = agent.group.position;
// move in xz only, y fixed at floor
const dx = target.x - pos.x, dz = target.z - pos.z;
const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
const step = speed * dt;
if (d <= step) { pos.x = target.x; pos.z = target.z; a.idx++; a._stallT = 0; a._prev = pos.clone(); if (a.idx >= a.path.length) return true; }
else { pos.x += dx/d*step; pos.z += dz/d*step;
  // face direction
  agent.group.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
  agent.group.userData.isWalking = true;
  // stall detection
  const moved = pos.distanceTo(a._prev);
  if (moved < 0.005) a._stallT += dt; else { a._stallT = 0; }
  a._prev.copy(pos);
  if (a._stallT > 1.2) { a.idx++; a._stallT = 0; }
}
return false;
```

```
        if (!agent.currentAction) {
            if (agent.plan.length === 0) break;

}
```

```
function startAction(a, act) {
    switch (act.type) {
        case 'WALK_TO_WP': {
            const fl = world.floors[act.floor];
            const nodes = fl.nodes;
            const startName = nearestNodeName(nodes, a.group.position);
            let path = bfsPath(nodes, startName, act.wp);
            if (!path || path.length === 0) { path = [nodes[act.wp].pos.clone()]; }
            act.path = path; act.idx = 0; act._stallT = 0; act._prev = a.group.position.clone();
            a.group.position.y = act.floor * WORLD.FLOOR_HEIGHT;
            a.currentFloor = act.floor;
            break;
        }
        case 'WAIT_AT_PANEL':
            if (act.dir > 0) elevator.callUp(act.floor); else elevator.callDown(act.floor);
            a.state = 'WAITING_ELEVATOR';
            break;
        case 'ENTER_ELEVATOR':
            act.phase = 'reserve'; act._spot = null; act._stallT = 0;
            break;
        case 'PRESS_FLOOR':
            elevator.pressDestination(act.floor);
            break;
        case 'EXIT_ELEVATOR':
            elevator.registerDisembark(a);
            act.phase = 'reparent';
            break;
        case 'SIT': {
            const fl = world.floors[act.floor];
            const st = fl.sitTargets[act.wp];
            const nodePos = fl.nodes[act.wp].pos;
            let px = nodePos.x, pz = nodePos.z;
            if (!st.sit) { const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2; const r = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.4; px += Math.cos(ang) * r; pz += Math.sin(ang) * r; }
            a.group.position.set(px, act.floor * WORLD.FLOOR_HEIGHT - (st.sit ? 0.35 : 0), pz);
            a.group.rotation.y = st.facing;
            a.group.userData.isSitting = st.sit;
            a.group.userData.isWalking = false;
            break;
        }
        case 'STAND':
            a.group.userData.isSitting = false;
            if (a.group.parent === elevator.carGroup) a.group.position.y = 0;
            else a.group.position.y = a.currentFloor * WORLD.FLOOR_HEIGHT;
            break;
        case 'RELEASE_SEAT':
            releaseSeatKey(a, act.floor, act.wp);
            break;
        case 'WAIT_SIM':
            act.untilMin = Clock.simMinute + act.minutes;
            break;
        case 'ENTER_STATE':
            a.state = act.state;
            break;
        case 'MARK_LUNCHED':
            a.hasLunched = true;
            break;
        case 'EXIT_BUILDING':
            if (a.group.parent) a.group.parent.remove(a.group);
            a.state = 'GONE';
            break;
        case 'PICK_NEXT_ACTIVITY':
            a.plan = chooseNextActivity(a);
            break;
    }
}
```

```
function updateWalk(a, act, dt) {
    const ud = a.group.userData;
    if (act.idx >= act.path.length) return true;
    const pos = a.group.position;
    const target = act.path[act.idx];
    const dx = target.x - pos.x, dz = target.z - pos.z;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    const step = 1.3 * dt;
    if (dist <= step) {
        pos.x = target.x; pos.z = target.z;
        act.idx++; act._stallT = 0; act._prev.copy(pos);
        return act.idx >= act.path.length;
    }
    pos.x += (dx / dist) * step;
    pos.z += (dz / dist) * step;
    a.group.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
    ud.isWalking = true;
    const moved = Math.hypot(pos.x - act._prev.x, pos.z - act._prev.z);
    act._stallT = moved < 0.005 ? act._stallT + dt : 0;
    act._prev.copy(pos);
    if (act._stallT > 1.2) { act.idx++; act._stallT = 0; }
    return false;
}
```

```
function updateEnterElevator(a, act, dt) {
    const fromY = act.floor * WORLD.FLOOR_HEIGHT;
    if (act.phase === 'reserve') {
        if (elevator.state !== 'DOOR_OPEN' || elevator.currentFloor !== act.floor) {
            if (act.dir > 0) elevator.callUp(act.floor); else elevator.callDown(act.floor);
            a.currentAction = { type: 'WAIT_AT_PANEL', floor: act.floor, dir: act.dir, toFloor: act.toFloor };
            startAction(a, a.currentAction);
            return false;
        }
        if (!act._spot) {
            act._spot = elevator.reserveBoardingSpot(a);
            if (!act._spot) return false;
            a._carSpot = act._spot;
        }
        act.phase = 'walkToDoor'; act._stallT = 0; act._prev = a.group.position.clone();
        return false;
    }
    if (act.phase === 'walkToDoor') {
        const pos = a.group.position;
```

```
function applyCollisions() {
    const active = [];
    for (const a of agents) {
        if (!a.group || !a.group.parent || a.state === 'GONE' || a.state === 'DISABLED' || a.state === 'AWAY') continue;
        active.push(a);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
        const A = active[i];
        if (A.group.userData.isSitting) continue;
        if (A.group.parent === elevator.carGroup) continue;
        for (let j = i + 1; j < active.length; j++) {
            const B = active[j];
            if (B.group.userData.isSitting) continue;
            if (B.group.parent !== A.group.parent) continue;
            if (B.group.parent === elevator.carGroup) continue;
            if (A._doorExempt || B._doorExempt) continue;
            const ca = A.currentAction, cb = B.currentAction;
            if ((ca && ca.type === 'ENTER_ELEVATOR') || (cb && cb.type === 'ENTER_ELEVATOR')) continue;
            const pa = A.group.position, pb = B.group.position;
            const dy = pa.y - pb.y;
            if (dy > 1 || dy < -1) continue;
            let dx = pa.x - pb.x, dz = pa.z - pb.z;
            let d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
            if (d >= 0.7) continue;
            if (d < 1e-3) { const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2; dx = Math.cos(ang); dz = Math.sin(ang); d = 1; }
            else { dx /= d; dz /= d; }
            const push = (0.7 - d) * 0.18 * 0.5;
            pa.x += dx * push; pa.z += dz * push;
            pb.x -= dx * push; pb.z -= dz * push;
        }
    }
}
```

```js
function bfsPath(nodes, fromName, toName) {
    if (!nodes[fromName] || !nodes[toName]) return [];
    if (fromName === toName) return [nodes[fromName].pos.clone()];
    const prev = {}; prev[fromName] = null;
    const queue = [fromName];
    while (queue.length) {
        const cur = queue.shift();
        const node = nodes[cur];
        for (let i = 0; i < node.links.length; i++) {
            const nxt = node.links[i];
            if (nxt in prev) continue;
            prev[nxt] = cur;
            if (nxt === toName) {
                const path = [];
                let walk = toName;
                while (walk) { path.push(nodes[walk].pos.clone()); walk = prev[walk]; }
                path.reverse();
                return path;
            }
            queue.push(nxt);
        }
    }
    return [];
}
```

I'm realizing the actual issue: `WAIT_AT_PANEL` executes the action to press the call every frame, and the logs confirm the calls were being registered in the system. But the real problem is that agents are getting stuck waiting in the `WAITING_ELEVATOR` state, not that the calls themselves aren't being pressed.

Looking at the timeline, the elevator is moving and serving some people, but there's a massive backlog of 33 agents waiting while the car cycles through. The timing math is the culprit: at 600x speed, the elevator takes about 0.7 real seconds per floor cycle, but the departure window is compressed into roughly 10 real seconds. With 40 people needing to descend and a capacity of 4, that's 10 trips needed — and the elevator simply can't keep up with the demand in that compressed timeframe. At the default 120x speed, this would scale differently.

But there's a deeper behavioral issue: workers on upper floors finish their day between 16:45 and 18:30, yet they're still showing as AT_DESK at 19:17 because their decision cycles are blocked by WAIT_SIM timers lasting up to 65 minutes. The departure override only triggers when they're in SURFACE_STATES, so they get stuck in these long wait states and never actually initiate their exit.

The real fix is to interrupt any WAIT_SIM action when departure time arrives — instead of just replacing the plan, I need to check if the current action is WAIT_SIM and clear it too, so the agent immediately stops waiting and starts moving to the elevator rather than sitting idle until the timer expires.

I'm also noticing the evening rush creates long queues at the elevator (22 people waiting by 17:36), which is expected congestion but the override bug was making it worse. I'll apply the currentAction clear fix and remove the panelPos additions from world.js since they're unused — keeping the code clean and following the spec exactly. content.thinking:
The elevator is working — it's moving 3–4 people per trip. But the number of people waiting on floors 4 and 5 isn't decreasing (6 and 7 persist), and it keeps increasing on the lower floors. In 2 sim minutes, the elevator transported about 25 people (5 trips × 4 + ...), yet the total waiting count stays at around 20–23. Who keeps re-adding them?

`waiters {"4":6,"5":7}` doesn't change at all. The elevator never visits floors 4 and 5 on these cycles! It's looping 0→1→2→3→0. Because after dropping off at 0, it picks the nearest job = floor 1 (downCalls is being continuously re-pressed by the waiters on floor 1 — new waiters keep arriving). It never reaches 4–5 because by the time it gets to 3, it's full (pax 4) → descends → 0 → nearest = 1 again. The downCalls on floors 4/5 remain, but the nearest-first selection always picks 1–2 first, and the car fills up by floor 3.

In an actual rush, this is half realistic, but floors 4–5 get starved forever. As long as there are people on floors 1–3, the nearest selection never picks 4/5. The people on floors 4/5 can only ride when the car happens to pass through… but the car only goes up as far as needed: from 0: nearest = 1. Picks up 3 on 1 (dst 0), then idle selection… no wait, at that point it's not idle: after door closes on 1: direction 0 (reset by my fix: no stops ahead in the dir 0 direction… wait, arrival dir 0 → _pickNextTarget: direction===0 → skip to idle selection: nearest job other than current floor: floor 2 (downCall) → up. Picks up on 2… full at 3 → down to 0. It never reaches 4/5!

Fix proposals:
1. In SCAN, continue in the direction of travel if there's work beyond: while picking up people and ascending, if downCalls exist at 4, 5 and capacity is available, continue ascending. My _pickNextTarget: after door closes on 3 (pax 4 full): direction… arrives at 3 with dir +1 (direction +1 from idle selection 2→3, reset only if passengers.size===0 — passengers 2 so dir stays +1? _handleArrival: reset direction only when passengers.size===0. After boarding on 3, pax=4. Door closes: dir +1: stops ahead: downCalls(4,5) are not stops in the +1 direction (only upCalls/dests count). destinations {0} is behind. → invert: nearest below = 0. Descends. So even with an empty seat… no, it was full.

The structural problem: downward hall calls don't count as stops in the upward direction (correct SCAN), and since the car fills up before reaching the top, the upper floors starve.

The actual solution during rush hour: the car should prioritize the farthest calls when the lower floors saturate — or simply, the idle selection shouldn't always pick "nearest". A common and practical fix: when the car is full, or when the nearest call's floor is already crowded, pick the farthest pending call. A simpler and more robust approach: use "longest-waiting call" or "farthest call" instead of nearest in the idle selection? The farthest-first would drain 5→4→3… and then nearest would drain 1, 2. Either extreme works; the nearest-first starves the far floors.

But mind the tests: test 1 asserts targetFloor > 0 (no problem). Test 2: dest 4 vs same-floor call — no problem. Test 3: reaches 2. Test 4: opposite-direction call waits — car heading up to dest 5: on door close at 5: flip -1: behind: downCalls(2) → target 2 ✓ regardless of nearest/farthest (only one stop).

Let's do this: the idle selection picks the farthest job floor (max |f-current|)… hmm, this ping-pongs to the farthest, but that's fine for draining. Actually, a better classic algorithm: continue the sweep. Let me reconsider: a cleaner fix that preserves "nearest" while preventing starvation: when selecting an idle target, if there are multiple hall calls, pick the one with the longest elapsed time. Requires per-call elapsed-time tracking: a floor → minutes map for calls. That's more bookkeeping in pure logic — doable: upCallTimes/downCallTimes Maps.

Simpler alternative: pick the farthest in the idle selection. Behavior: from 0: farthest job = 5 → ascend: pass 1, 2, 3, 4 (downCalls are not upward stops) → arrive at 5, pick up 4, descend: stops in -1 direction: dests {0} + downCalls 4, 3, 2, 1 → pick up along the way until full: 4 on 5, full → descend non-stop to 0. Next: farthest of remaining {1,2,3,4}: 4 → up… this drains top-down.

But morning rush (upward traffic from lobby): farthest selection from 0: dests/calls: lobby boarders press dests 3, 5, … — dests are on board, so no problem.

Also mid-day random trips: no problem.

Hmm, but farthest-first has a subtle problem: the car repeatedly zooms past lower-floor waiters to the top — looks unnatural but drains everyone. The real elevator SCAN in the direction of travel picks up along the way (for upCalls on the way up). In evening downward traffic, the car ascends empty to 5 (passes floors 1–4 where people are waiting to go down — a real elevator going up empty wouldn't pick up down-callers either… actually, a real elevator going up empty with no in-car dests should ideally stop for down-callers, but classical SCAN doesn't).

Better hybrid: keep nearest-first, but if a call has waited longer than threshold T (say, 30 sim minutes… at 300x this is 6 real seconds), prioritize the longest-waiting. Let's implement per-call elapsed time — cleaner behavior.

Actually, the simplest and most robust approach used in many elevator katas: track the insertion time of each hall call, and the idle selection picks the oldest call. Implement: this.upCallAge = Map(floor → minutes at press time)? ElevatorLogic has no clock; pass a time parameter? callUp(floor) takes no time… it could track "press order" via an increasing counter: this._callSeq++; store seq per call; the idle selection picks the call with the smallest seq (oldest). Destinations (in-car) still take priority over hall calls, per the existing rules.

But _pickNextTarget's directional sweep continues to use the floor set; only the idle selection uses the oldest. And "prefer continuation in current direction" happens first anyway.

Let's implement:
- this.callSeq = 0; this.upCallSeq = new Map(); this.downCallSeq = new Map();
- callUp: if not present, upCallSeq.set(floor, ++callSeq); upCalls.add.
- callDown similarly.

The simulation is complete and verified. Seven files were built from scratch in the workspace:

- **`index.html`** — exact mandated script order (Three.js 0.147.0 + OrbitControls from CDN, then the five local scripts).
- **`person.js`** — hip/shoulder-pivoted limbs, nose for facing, walk/sit animator.
- **`world.js`** — 6-floor transparent building with real 3-unit entrance gap, 4 offices + conference + lounge per floor, full lobby (cafe, bistro, lounges, pit, reception, kiosk, coolers, loiter spots), BFS nav graph, chunky call panels with cached canvas-digit textures.
- **`elevator_logic.js`** — pure 5-state scheduler with SCAN direction handling, capacity spots, door hold/cap, anti-starvation guards, and oldest-call-first idle pick.
- **`elevator.js`** — yellow car, sliding doors, destination buttons, in-car/shaft indicators, thin adapter over the logic.
- **`sim.js`** — lockstep clock (1–600x slider), day/night keyframes, 20 workers + 80 recycled visitors with full daily schedules, plan compilers, substepped render loop, HUD with occupancy slider.
- **`elevator_logic_test.js`** — 8/8 deterministic tests pass.

Debugging surfaced and fixed four real behavioral bugs: unbounded frame deltas skipping door timers (fixed with logic substeps), agents sampling door state too rarely at high speed (adaptive sim substeps), far-floor starvation (oldest-call scheduling + direction reset on turnaround), and a leave-plan re-trigger loop that bounced workers up/down forever (sticky `leaving` flag + exit overshoot guard).
